In the center, an old man in a grey scarf sits on a wooden bench, watching the scene with a gentle smile. Beside him, a brown dog rests its head on his knee, looking up expectantly. A street vendor in a green apron hands a wrapped pastry to a teenager in a denim jacket who is reaching out with both hands. Behind them, a red brick building features arched windows reflecting the overcast sky. To the right, a cyclist in a neon vest leans against a lamppost, adjusting their helmet. Near the cyclist, a black cat sits atop a stone planter, grooming its paw. A couple in matching purple scarves walks hand in hand past a fountain that is frozen solid with icicles hanging from its rim. A golden retriever runs through the snow, kicking up white powder as it chases a frisbee thrown by a boy in an orange beanie. The boy laughs, his mouth open in mid-shout. An elderly lady in a floral shawl feeds pigeons near the base of a statue depicting a historical figure on horseback. The statue is covered in a thin layer of frost. A bus driver in a navy uniform stands by an open door, checking a wristwatch. A tourist in a bright pink backpack takes a photo with a silver camera, aiming it toward the fountain. A street musician in a battered fedora plays a violin, his case open on the ground for tips. There is no sun visible in the grey sky. There is no traffic moving on the cobblestones. There is no digital signage or modern advertisements present.
